english.note: For an organized system of rules or management, this is the all-purpose choice, including a prison regime.

exampleSentences.english: The prison regime is so strict that inmates cannot even choose their visiting time.
exampleSentences.traditional: 監獄制度太嚴，犯人連探訪時間都冇得揀。

english.note: Use this for institution as a socially established system or practice, as in marriage.

exampleSentences.english: Marriage is an important institution in society.
exampleSentences.traditional: 婚姻係社會上一項重要制度。
